newsitem.title: USA: U.S. factory orders down more than expected in May.
newsitem.headline: U.S. factory orders down more than expected in May.

text.p: Weak demand for new cars and airplanes helped push the value of new orders to U.S. factories down more sharply than anticipated during May, the Commerce Department said on Wednesday.

Orders fell 0.7 percent to a seasonally adjusted $323.3 billion -- the second drop in the past three months -- after a revised 1.4 percent increase in April orders and a 1.7 percent decline in March. Wall Street economists had forecast only a 0.2 percent falloff in May orders.
Shipments and order backlogs also weakened from April.
